newsitem.title: USA: Dollar General to consolidate 350 jobs.
newsitem.headline: Dollar General to consolidate 350 jobs.

text.p: Dollar General Corp said on Tuesday it would consolidate about 350 administrative jobs, because it was relocating some of its offices.
The company said it planned to move some of its Nashville and Scottsville, Ky. offices to Goodlettsville, Tenn. and it would expand and upgrade its distribution headquarters in Scottsville.

"Our company has grown out of its Nashville and Scottsville office space and needs to consolidate about 350 administrative positions for greater efficiency," said Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Cal Turner Jr.
The company said it would purchase a 28-acre site in Goodlettsville and construct new offices in the Northchase office complex near Rivergate Mall.
Dollar General is a chain of more than 2,691 neighborhood stores in 24 states with distribution centers in Kentucky, Georgia and Oklahoma.
